description: Answers 'is it going to rain (today/tomorrow)' from met.no's hourly forecast: when rain starts and roughly how much. Added 2026-11-06 for the bedroom Echo's voice control. Opens the weather page on the screen in the asking satellite's area (writes input_text.overlook_voice; card option voice).

variables.day: {{ (now() + timedelta(days=1 if 'tomorrow' in trigger.sentence | lower else 0)).date() | string }}

data.value: {{ {'area': (area_id(trigger.device_id) if trigger.device_id else ''), 'action': 'weather', 'range': 'day', 'dates': [day], 't': now().timestamp() | int} | to_json }}

actions.set_conversation_response: {% set ns = namespace(total=0, first=none, last=none) %}{% for h in hours %}{% set t = as_local(as_datetime(h.datetime)) %}{% if (t.date() | string) == day and (tomorrow or t >= now() - timedelta(hours=1)) and (h.precipitation | float(0)) >= 0.2 %}{% set ns.total = ns.total + (h.precipitation | float(0)) %}{% if ns.first is none %}{% set ns.first = t %}{% endif %}{% set ns.last = t %}{% endif %}{% endfor %}{% set when = 'tomorrow' if tomorrow else 'today' %}{% if ns.first is none %}No, no rain is forecast {{ when }}.{% else %}{% set amt = ns.total | round(0) | int %}{% set start = ns.first.strftime('%-I %p') | lower | replace(' ', '') %}{% set size = 'light rain' if ns.total < 2 else ('some rain' if ns.total < 8 else 'heavy rain') %}Yes, {{ size }} {{ when }} from about {{ start }}{% if amt >= 1 %}, around {{ amt }} millimetres{% endif %}.{% endif %}
